podcast.title: Early 2000s Revival
podcast.body: The early 2000s saw a significant Indy Rock revival, marked by the emergence of exciting and powerful new bands. This movement included groups such as The White Stripes, The Strokes, Interpol, the Yeah Yeah Yeahs, Franz Ferdinand, Arctic Monkeys, Arcade Fire, The Killers, and The Hives. "They were a major part of the Indy Rock revival of the early 2000s, the rise of exciting and powerful new bands like the Strokes and Interpol, the YAAs, Fransford Nan, Arctic Monkeys, Arcade Fire, the Killers, the Hives, and a few dozen more."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Revival in Late 90s/Early 2000s
podcast.body: Indy Rock experienced a revival in the late 1990s and early 2000s, emerging as a rebirth of the Brit Pop scene. "But that gets tired after a while but is reborn under the guise of Indy Rock in the late 90s and early 2000s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
